correctness.rationale: For any period-three state the firing-count vector belongs to the connected graph Laplacian kernel, so each vertex fires exactly once or twice in three rounds. The chip values for a chosen once-per-three firing phase are exactly the derived threshold intervals; nonempty supports force all three phase classes on the three-vertex side to have size one. The labelled phase assignment and bounded chip offsets establish the multinomial polynomial Q_b. Inclusion-exclusion yields its rational closed expression; palindromicity plus the chip-complement involution yields the second band. Direct full-state enumeration for b=3 and 4 and independent polynomial checks for b=3..30 passed. All cases b>=3 are proved; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The minimum bipartite side size supporting primitive period three is three (by the earlier period classification). The exact full-mass census of this natural onset family gives positive populations precisely at both mass endpoints of the known strict middle-stair period-two theorem; neither endpoint can be included in that theorem even for K_{3,b}. The disjoint complete bands and explicit orbit growth are structural invariants relevant to fixed-energy sandpile dynamics, not a convenience parameter slice.
